STALE -- run_revocation_checks no longer does index arithmetic. It iterates sans_io::revocation_targets(chain, anchors, validated), which yields a typed RevocationTarget per certificate (Issuer{cert,issuer} or Anchor{cert,anchor}).

That is a better answer than the chain.windows(2) + chain.last() the bead proposed: the sync path and a caller driving the checks themselves now read the same list, so they cannot disagree about which certificates need checking -- which windows(2) in two places would not have prevented.
